steps.detail: Cleveland starts Griffin (5.19 ERA) with a bullpen that just pitched a five-game ALDS; rested Rays start Rasmussen off eight no-hit innings.
steps.label: Our read

note: Cleveland starts Griffin (5.19 ERA) with a bullpen that just pitched a five-game ALDS; rested Rays start Rasmussen off eight no-hit innings.
reasoning: Pinnacle has Rays -1.5 at 2.33, a fair 41.7%; our read is 45.5%, worth +4.7% at 2.30.
Griffin: 5.19 ERA in 9 starts for Cleveland; Cleveland says it wants length from him, which usually means a short leash and early bullpen.
Cleveland's ALDS went five games and ended Saturday; closer Cade Smith pitched in all five. Tampa Bay swept and has been off since Wednesday.
Rasmussen threw eight no-hit innings with 10 strikeouts in ALDS Game 1 and seven scoreless innings against Cleveland in July.
Cleveland's offense (93 wRC+) is the weaker of the two; a Rays win is more likely to be by two or more than by one when the losing side's pitching is stretched.
risks: Griffin goes deep (5+ innings) and Cleveland's top relievers are fresh enough for a one-run game.
Rays win by exactly one: the most common winning margin in a low-scoring playoff game.
Price: below 2.27 the edge is gone.

sources.title: Yahoo: Probable starters for ALCS Game 1

summary: Cleveland has to cover Game 1 with Foster Griffin (5.19 ERA in nine starts since the trade) and a bullpen that just pitched a full five-game ALDS, against a rested Rays team starting Drew Rasmussen off eight no-hit innings. That gap shows up late, which is what the run line pays for.
